Gipfel des Steigflugs

The calculated point along the flight path where an aircraft completes its climb and levels off at cruising altitude as programmed in the FMS.

Questions and answers

What is Gipfel des Steigflugs?

In this glossary, Gipfel des Steigflugs refers to: The calculated point along the flight path where an aircraft completes its climb and levels off at cruising altitude as programmed in the FMS.

How is Gipfel des Steigflugs used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Melden Sie das Erreichen des Gipfels des Steigflugs, nivellieren Sie auf Flugfläche drei-sechs-null und melden Sie den Abschluss der Reiseflugkontrollen."

Definition

The calculated point along the flight path where an aircraft completes its climb and levels off at cruising altitude as programmed in the FMS.

Operational example

Advise reaching top of climb, level at flight level three-six-zero and report cruise checks complete.
